Lock ordering among address space lock, interval tree lock, region semaphore, filesystem hooks and security hooks.
Address selection, merging, splitting, fault handling and teardown outside creation and completion helpers shown.
Huge page daemon enrollment criteria, same page merging eligibility updates, and soft dirty accounting beyond flag updates shown.
Architecture specific flag validation, userfaultfd completion, and performance or probe notification semantics.

findings.text: System mapping entry by page offset distinguishes file backed and anonymous requests, performs descriptor lookup and auditing for file cases, aligns lengths for huge page files or anonymous huge page requests, constructs anonymous huge page backing with no-reserve behavior, delegates to the generic mapper, and balances file references on exit.

Generic mapping wrapper translates page offset to byte offset, applies access control and notification permission gates, acquires address space write ownership in killable form, invokes the core mapper with populate and userfaultfd carriers, releases ownership, completes userfaultfd bookkeeping, and optionally instantiates the requested range.

No-memory-management-unit core mapper validates the request, enforces a global mapping count ceiling, allocates region and area descriptors, derives legacy protection from modern flags and capabilities, handles sharing discovery or direct device placement, instantiates shared or private backing, clears fresh anonymous storage unless uninitialized use is jointly allowed, registers the region and area, flushes instruction cache once for first executable use, and unwinds references and allocations on failure.

Public helper attaches zero backed shared memory file behavior to an area, replacing any prior file reference and associating anonymous shared memory operations, propagating file creation failure to the caller.
Public constructor creates a private kernel internal shared memory file on the shared memory mount with supplied name, byte size and mapping flags.
Public accounting helper adds a page count to the total address space size and to exactly one of execution, stack or data counters according to mapping classification.

Public preparation dispatcher validates an action override value then selects per-type preparation for frame remap variants and kernel page mapping, accepting only the no-op action on no-memory-management-unit builds and reporting malformed actions as errors.

An area is treated as anonymous only when no file participates and shared behavior is not requested; private file-less mappings use zero device backing or fall back to anonymous marking when no driver operations are supplied.
Data accounting applies exclusively to writable mappings that are neither shared nor stack; execution and stack classifications take precedence when updating per-class resident counters.

Early merging flag assignment is regarded as stable for file-less mappings, for drivers using the newer prepare callback, and for shared memory files, but not for legacy driver map callbacks that might later mutate flags and affect eligibility.

Deny write plus execute policy constrains only processes opted into the mode and only mappings requesting execution; it forbids newly writable executable areas and transitions that add execution to a previously non-executable area.

Zero device backing size derives from the area length as end minus start and the resulting file is private to the mapping, avoiding directory and security ordering conflicts during creation under address space lock.
Linkage of a file backed area against reverse mapping acquires address space interval tree write ownership across linkage, with a caller controlled option to retain that ownership after return.
A new area is placed into write mode before becoming visible in the area tree, and the unmap descriptor used for driver failure rollback records that address space write ownership is already held.

The generic mapping path holds address space write ownership across core mapping and userfaultfd list preparation, while the no-memory-management-unit path holds a global region semaphore in write mode across sharing search, instantiation and tree insertion, releasing on all exits.

The unmap descriptor used for rollback captures the iterator cursor, the first area, page bounds derived from neighboring areas or from system floor and ceiling defaults, the area bounds being undone, tree truncation and reset positions, and a flag recording held write ownership of the address space.

Fresh area creation allocates a descriptor, positions the iterator, initializes anonymity and range plus protection state, reserves iterator space, attaches type specific backing with cleanup on failure, refreshes deferred merging flags when not done early, performs architecture flag sanity, then inserts under write mode with count increment and file linkage and opportunistic huge page daemon enrollment for non-anonymous areas.

File backed attachment pins the file unless already pinned and succeeds immediately when the driver offers no map operation; on driver mapping failure it drops the reference, repositions the iterator, undoes partial device mappings over the attempted range and propagates the error, while on success it checks address stability and writability non-escalation and adopts driver adjusted flags and file.

Post insertion completion notifies performance and probe subsystems, finalizes detachment of overlapped areas, applies statistical accounting, either clears unsupported locking or charges locked pages, marks fresh or expanded areas soft dirty when supported, and refreshes derived page protections.

Mapping preparation chains filesystem preparation followed by generic action preparation with first failure propagated; on success it synchronizes page offset, possibly adopts a replacement file without extra reference, adopts updated flags and protections, and carries driver operations and private data forward for later area initialization.

No-memory-management-unit request validation rejects fixed placement, unsupported sharing types, empty or oversized or overflowing lengths, unmappable or inaccessible files, mismatched shared or private capabilities and disallowed execution transitions, while deriving direct device versus copy capabilities from driver hooks, file type, open mode and protections and consulting personality execution implication and security address approval.

No-memory-management-unit shared instantiation searches existing shared regions for same file overlap, ignores non-shared or disjoint entries, generally requires exact or subset match unless direct capability permits skipping inexact overlap, otherwise reports sharing violation; on a usable hit it shares region storage with adjusted bounds and shared file setup, on a miss it queries the driver for direct placement with fallback to copying when permitted.

Drivers must not alter the area start address and must not newly grant writability when the mapping was created without that permission; such deviations are flagged as warnings for diagnosis rather than silently accepted.

Unexpected architecture flag state and malformed action override values are treated as warnings plus errors, and no-memory-management-unit builds warn when special remap actions are requested that they cannot honor.

No-memory-management-unit mapping reports mapping count exhaustion, iterator reservation failure with memory diagnostics, region or area allocation failure, and sharing mismatch; reservation failure after private copy allocation additionally releases the copied pages to avoid leakage.

Fresh anonymous private storage is explicitly cleared unless uninitialized contents are jointly enabled by build option and request flag, and instruction cache flushing for a region happens at most once on its first executable mapping.

Mapping failures use a negative errno vocabulary distinguishing bad descriptor, invalid argument, access or permission denial, missing device support, range overflow, interrupted lock acquisition, and out of memory or mapping count exhaustion.

Mapping behavior is selected by standard protection and disposition bits for read, write, execute, shared, private, fixed, anonymous, huge page and uninitialized hints, plus internal direct, read, write, execute and copy capability bits and legacy writable, shared and stack classification bits.
